architectureDecisions: D1 — CLI-wins independently per flag. commandDeliverCli today maps only slice/command/recoveryDir. commandDeliver already reads maxAttempts/timeoutMs (camel or kebab) and Number()s them into runDeliverSlice, which does maxAttemptsOption ?? slice.maxAttempts ?? 3 and timeoutMsOption ?? slice.timeoutMs ?? 600000. Map --max-attempts / --timeout-ms through commandDeliverCli into commandDeliver. If the CLI flag is present, that value wins; if omitted, commandDeliver sees undefined and keeps slice then 3/600000. Providing only one flag does not force the other. Same pattern as recoveryDir: options["recovery-dir"] ?? null. DELIVERED_TRUTH: audit deliverCliPassesMaxAttempts false, deliverCliPassesTimeoutMs false, commandDeliverAcceptsMaxAttempts true, commandDeliverAcceptsTimeoutMs true.

D2 — USAGE must list both flags on the deliver line: [--max-attempts N] [--timeout-ms T]. Header comment matches. Parse via existing parseOptions (every flag takes a value). When a flag is present, commandDeliverCli runs positiveInteger(options["max-attempts"], "--max-attempts") / positiveInteger(options["timeout-ms"], "--timeout-ms") so non-positive and non-integer fail as UsageError before commandDeliver or spawn, matching commandRun. Do not call Number() in the CLI path.

D3 — Do not write deliver-slice.js. commandDeliver and runDeliverSlice already apply the options to every Backend runSupervisedTask/resumeSupervisedTask call. QA is unchanged. No second default schema.

D4 — Tests in packages/agent-tools/test/deliver-cli-limits.test.js. P1: spawn BIN deliver --max-attempts 1 --timeout-ms 5000 with fake FIX_FIRST ACCEPTED; the Backend run uses those limits (observable via onHandleWrite handle.maxAttempts or attempt count). P2: CLI --max-attempts 1 overrides manifest maxAttempts 3; omitted --timeout-ms keeps manifest timeoutMs. N1: BIN deliver --max-attempts 0 and --max-attempts 1.5 and --max-attempts nope each exit 2 with UsageError before any agent process; commandDeliver({ maxAttempts: 0 }) still TypeError from runDeliverSlice. N2: BIN deliver without those flags keeps manifest maxAttempts/timeoutMs when set, else 3/600000. Hermetic fake CLI; deliver-slice.test.js stays green.

D5 — Living docs. operator.md deliver USAGE gains [--max-attempts N] [--timeout-ms T], CLI-wins independently, omitted keeps manifest then 3/600000, invalid integers fail before spawn. state.md operator deliver sentence names the same flags. No Blackboard ids.
